column1: # Custom partition table for 4MB flash with OTA support — headless variant
# - Maximize app partition size while keeping dual OTA partitions (app0/app1)
# - Drop the (unused) SPIFFS data partition on headless boards
# - Keep a small coredump partition for crash diagnostics
# Safe for boards with HAS_DISPLAY=false (and HAS_SD_STORAGE=false). Such
# boards never call Storage.begin() or LittleFS mount — the SPIFFS partition
# is effectively dead weight and is removed here to give the firmware more
# - Offsets (except nvs/otadata) must be aligned to 0x10000 (64KB)
# - The FQBN option `PartitionScheme=ota_2mb` must match this filename (without .csv)
